descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S27 Wrong browser clock and another time zone: the note's 'today' values and dates match a correctly set browser (web, both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U17 'Today' for the note (which vitals and labs count as today's, and the date written into the note) follows the server clock; a device with a wrong date or another time zone gives the same note. … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92592 AC 16) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U11 The note never presents a vital or lab from a previous day as today's; earlier values appear only with their date (e.g. 'Cr 1.1 on Oct 1'); if no vitals were dictated today, the note says so. … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.7; TFA-92592 AC 16) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Two browser contexts on the same fresh account: one with the correct clock and zone, one with page.clock one day ahead and timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu'. The Hospital patient is seeded like H-18 (132/80, HR 88, 37.4 °C, SpO2 95% at {day-1} 07:00; …

When In the wrong-clock context: open the patient, Encounter tab, type the H-18 / N-21 encounter text, press Generate Note & Finish, read the note on Post-Round and the date labels of the stored values on Pre-Round. Then regenerate in the correct context and read the same

Then Both contexts treat the stored values the same: in neither is a {day-1} / {day-14} value presented as today's, both notes say no vitals were dictated today, and the date written into the note and the date label next to each stored value are the server's day, not the browser's

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per mode, each saved note (backend probe after each Generate) gets S18's checks for H-18 / N-21 (valuesOnlyWithDate, the 'no vitals today' statement in the vitals / objective section), and the two contexts are compared with each other (note date line, value date labels on Pre-Round). Any difference between the contexts fails U17. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
